text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- King Hussein meets the visiting chief of the Turkish airforce, discussions on boosting bilateral defence ties.

- Trade and Industry Minister Ali Abu Al-Ragheb, during a visit to PLO's Orient House and Jerusalem's al-Aqsa Mosque, says Jordanian-Palestinian coordination "is strong and the success of the Cairo economic summit is dependant on the peace process".
- Indonesian President visits Jordan on Monday.
- PLO's Kaddoumi expected in Amman on Friday to meet senior Jordanian officials.
- King meets top executives of U.S. McDonald's Corp after the fast-food gaint opened its first restaurant in Jordan.
- Prime Minister Kabariti says Jordan is "beacon of democracy."
